source.generator: manual — Devin CLI writes ATIF documents at ~/.local/share/devin/cli/transcripts/<session>.json

notes: devin transcripts are single ATIF JSON documents (schema_version ATIF-v1.7), not JSONL; the reader parses the whole file
entry.id is the ATIF step_id (string or number); next_cursor is the first entry id of the page
system steps (sysprompt/telemetry) are skipped; agent steps wire tool_calls to same-step observation.results via source_call_id
files[].jsonl_lines carries the whole document as a single line; append_jsonl_lines cannot model devin's rewrite-in-place update, so live-tail coverage lives in the browser subscription tests
env."HERDR_DEVIN_DATA_DIRS" points the XDG-based root resolution at the materialized HOME
